name: Naga Shaman
lines: (5 items) When you apply a damage shield to yourself or an ally, you gain Minor Mending and Minor Vitality for 6 seconds, increasing your healing done by 8% and healing received and damage shield strength by 6%. This effect can occur once every 6 seconds.

name: Nazaray
lines: (2 items) When you use an Ultimate ability, the closest 6 enemies within 12 meters have all Major and Minor debuffs applied to them extended by 1 second per 20 Ultimate spent. This effect can occur once every 30 seconds per target.

name: Necropotence
lines: (5 items) While you have a summoned combat pet active your Max Magicka is increased by 14%.

name: Nerien'eth
lines: (1 item) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(2 items) When you deal direct damage, you have a 15% chance to conjure a Lich crystal that explodes after 2 seconds, dealing 1360 Magic damage to all enemies within 4 meters. This effect can occur once every 3 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Netch Oil
lines: (5 items) While you have Crowd Control Immunity, you are immune to Snares and Immobilizations.

name: Netch's Touch
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 400 Weapon and Spell Damage to your Shock Damage abilities.

name: New Moon Acolyte
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 401 Weapon and Spell Damage. Increases the cost of your active abilities by 5%.

name: Nibenay Bay Battlereeve
lines: (2 items) When you are forcefully moved via a Pull, Knockback or Teleport ability, gain a damage shield that absorbs up to 15112 damage for 6 seconds. This damage shield is not affected by Battle Spirit. This effect can occur once every 14 seconds. While you do not have the damage shield from this set, reduce your damage taken from players by 5%.

name: Night Mother's Embrace
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 171 Weapon and Spell Damage, Reduces the radius you can be detected while Sneaking by 2 meters. Reduces the cost of Sneak by 25%.

name: Night Mother's Gaze
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you deal Critical Damage you apply Major Breach to the enemy, reducing their Physical and Spell Resistance by 5948 for 4 seconds.
